rider.label: Rider name
home.first.title: One step to the start gate
home.first.lead: Downhill Revived plays from **your own copy** of Downhill Domination (USA, SCUS-97177) as an .iso file. It is checked here and remembered; nothing leaves your PC.
home.first.leadImport: Downhill Revived plays from **your own copy** of Downhill Domination (USA, SCUS-97177) as an .iso file. It is checked and copied into the app once; nothing leaves your device.
home.first.step1Hint: Any folder; the file stays where it is
home.first.step1HintImport: It needs about 2.5 GB of free space. Free now: {free}.
home.first.step2Hint: PLAY appears below once the disc checks out
crash.title: Downhill Revived closed unexpectedly last time
crash.body: {why} Sharing the log helps get it fixed: it says what happened.
online.checking: Checking the disc image for online races… {percent}%
online.offlineOnly: Offline only: this disc image's game files are different from the USA disc's (SCUS-97177): a bad or modified dump. Make a new dump or choose another image.
server.upEmpty: Race server up · no public races right now
settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: The same settings as REVIVED SETTINGS in the game, saved to dhd.ini. Changes apply the next time the game starts.
settings.subTouch: The same settings as SETTINGS in the game, saved to dhd.ini. Changes apply the next time the game starts.
row.scale.hint: How sharp the 3D picture is drawn. 1x is the PS2's own.
row.scale.limit.memory: Your GPU's memory allows up to {limit}x
row.scale.limit.texture: Your GPU's largest texture allows up to {limit}x
row.scale.capped.gpu: Your GPU allows up to {limit}x; {asked}x runs at {limit}x
row.scale.capped.memory: Your GPU's memory allows up to {limit}x; {asked}x runs at {limit}x
row.scale.capped.texture: Your GPU's largest texture allows up to {limit}x; {asked}x runs at {limit}x
row.scale.window: Match window ran at {used}x last time
row.scale.window.gpu: Match window ran at {used}x last time; your GPU allows up to {limit}x
row.scale.window.memory: Match window ran at {used}x last time; your GPU's memory allows up to {limit}x
row.scale.window.texture: Match window ran at {used}x last time; your GPU's largest texture allows up to {limit}x
row.scale.hintPhone: How sharp the 3D picture is drawn. 1x is the PS2's own; higher scales need a faster phone.
row.aspect.hint: Wide fits your monitor's shape; 16:9 is always 16:9
row.aspect.hintTouch: Wide fits your screen's shape; 16:9 is always 16:9
row.fps.hint: Game steps a second, offline and online.
row.perfCounter.hint: Show presented frames per second and online ping.
row.textures.hint: Uses the installed PCSX2 texture pack
row.textures.none: No pack found. README.txt says where one goes.
row.nativeVu.hint: The GPU runs the PS2's VU1 programs, which is faster. Turn it off if the picture looks wrong.
row.performance.hint: Turns off shadows, the sun's glow, the lens flare and particles, for speed.
row.performance.custom: Some effects are off: SETTINGS in the game sets them one by one.
row.widescreen.hint: A wider view, with the HUD and menus kept in shape
row.disc.inApp: Downhill Domination (USA), copied into the app: {size}
row.unlockAll.hint: Every track, rider, bike and shop item; your save is not changed
row.updates.hint: Online races need the newest version
row.updates.hintPhone: Looks for a new release each time the launcher opens and says so here. Nothing is downloaded.
row.launcher: Open the launcher at every start
row.launcher.hint: Off: the game starts at once. SETTINGS in the game turns the launcher back on.
row.language.hint: The launcher's language. The game's own menus stay in English.
row.deadZone.hint: How far a stick moves before the rider responds. Game is the PS2's own.
row.prompts.hint: The buttons the game shows. Auto follows your controller.
row.names.hint: Names above other riders in online races. Medium is the original size.
row.name: Rider name
row.name.hint: Shown over your rider in online races. {rule}
row.server.hint: Leave empty for the official server
row.discord.hint: Shows what you are playing on your Discord profile while Discord runs
row.touchPreset.hint: Classic pad has every PS2 button; Thumb zones puts riding under your thumbs.
row.touchHand.hint: Left mirrors the controls and the HUD.
row.touchSteer.hint: The stick, tilting the device, or a D-pad.
row.touchSize.hint: Auto fits the controls to your screen.
row.touchEdit.hint: Starts the game in its layout editor: drag the controls where your thumbs rest.
disc.importingCloud: A file on a cloud drive is downloaded first: this can take a few minutes.
disc.keepOpen: Keep the app open: this takes a minute or two.
disc.copied: The disc image is copied and checked.
disc.deleteAsk: The game has its own copy now. The file you chose still takes {size}: delete it to get that space back?
disc.problem.noRoom: This disc image needs {need} of free space, and the device has {free}. Free up some space, then try again.
disc.problem.noPicker: This device has no file picker.
disc.problem.outOfSpace: The device ran out of space while copying.
notes.title: What's new in {version}
notes.waiting: Patch notes appear here once the launcher reaches GitHub.
notes.missing: The patch notes for {version} couldn't be loaded here. Read them on GitHub.
help.title: Help
help.log.hint: Sends the game's log through the share sheet: it says what happened, so a report needs no questions.
help.licences.hint: Downhill Revived is free software under the GPL-3.0-or-later; the libraries it uses keep their own licences.
footer.closeAsk: Close the game? Progress since your last save is lost.
footer.isRunning: The game is running. The launcher comes back when it closes.
footer.noGame: The game isn't in this folder. Unzip the whole release together.
footer.discProblem: The disc image chosen before can't be used
footer.unavailable: Version **{version}**. No update package is published for this platform yet.
footer.checkFailed: Couldn't check for updates. You can still play {version}.
footer.out: Version **{version}** is out. Install it from the release page.
bind.title: Bindings
bind.keysHint: Keys by their place on the keyboard. Esc always goes back and pauses.
bind.padHint: By the button's place on the controller. Every controller of this player uses this layout.
bind.badKey: That key can't be used: Esc, Alt, Ctrl and the Windows keys stay the game's and the system's
bind.howTo: Click a key or button to change it, right-click to clear it. A key or button another one had moves here.
bind.swapL.hint: For controllers that report L1 as L2 and L2 as L1
bind.swapR.hint: For controllers that report R1 as R2 and R2 as R1
stick.live: Ring: your stick. Dot: what the rider gets. Shaded: no effect.
stick.none: Connect a controller and move a stick to see the dead zone.
